scripts.test: npm run test:localization && npm run test:signing-isolation && npm run test:release-toolchain && npm run test:unit-isolation && npm run test:app-compile && npm run test:unit
scripts.test:app-compile: xcodebuild build -project TokenStats.xcodeproj -scheme TokenStats -configuration Debug -destination 'platform=macOS' LM_SKIP_METADATA_EXTRACTION=YES REGISTER_WITH_LAUNCH_SERVICES=NO CODE_SIGN_STYLE=Manual CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY=- DEVELOPMENT_TEAM= PROVISIONING_PROFILE_SPECIFIER=
scripts.test:unit: xcodebuild test -project TokenStats.xcodeproj -scheme TokenStats -destination 'platform=macOS' -only-testing:TokenStatsTests CODE_SIGN_STYLE=Manual CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY=- DEVELOPMENT_TEAM= PROVISIONING_PROFILE_SPECIFIER=
scripts.test:ui: xcodebuild test -project TokenStats.xcodeproj -scheme TokenStatsUITests -destination 'platform=macOS' -only-testing:TokenStatsUITests CODE_SIGN_STYLE=Manual CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY=- DEVELOPMENT_TEAM= PROVISIONING_PROFILE_SPECIFIER=
scripts.build: xcodebuild -project TokenStats.xcodeproj -scheme TokenStats -configuration Release -derivedDataPath build build
